assumption_cross_check.assessment: The exact 20-field contract is implemented in a local SQLite harness and tested, but no reviewed source confirms that the originating eight-column requirement meant this VCF core. The schema remains an accelerator assumption.
Synthetic dataset bindings and local query scenarios exist, but they do not validate hereditary-cancer screening as the confirmed demo scenario or as a clinical use case.
Six local access-aware view models are implemented and tested, but the chosen screen set remains a proposed accelerator choice without reviewed external confirmation.
The local harness records a clustering strategy and maintenance state, but SQLite does not execute Delta optimization and representative-volume validation has not confirmed the strategy.
A 1,000 ms local synthetic query target is measured and explicitly labelled an assumption. The end-to-end accelerator KPI task remains open and no production target is confirmed.

Purview lineage, deployed Databricks or Fabric surfaces, Azure ML or AI Foundry, and the governed query server are not implemented. Service selection remains deployment configuration and an assumption.
Current repository evidence documents a personal public repository and tier substitutes, but that deployment choice is not a confirmed requirement for every accelerator deployment.
Documentation is written for a solution-engineer demo, but the first-reader dry run remains open and no reviewed confirmation changes the proposed audience into a product commitment.
No cleared customer attribution is recorded. The automated review continues to prohibit customer deployment claims, so the earlier attributions remain unverified and excluded.
